import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long total, factor, cycleCount;
    static int[] visited;

    static long powMod(long base, long exponent) {
        long res = 1;
        for (int i = 30; i >= 0; i--) {
            res = (res * res) % 1000000007;
            if (((long)1 << i & exponent) != 0) {
                res = (res * base) % 1000000007;
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        total = sc.nextLong();
        factor = sc.nextLong();
        visited = new int[(int) total];
        cycleCount = 0;

        if (factor == 1) {
            System.out.println(powMod(total, total));
            sc.close();
            return;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < total; i++) {
            if (visited[i] == 0) {
                visited[i] = 1;
                cycleCount++;
                long current = (i * factor) % total;
                while (visited[(int) current] == 0) {
                    visited[(int) current] = 1;
                    current = (current * factor) % total;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(powMod(total, cycleCount));
        sc.close();
    }
}
